I, Munasingha Kariyawasam Appuhamilage Don SomadasaGunawardana, Minister of Lands, hereby declare under Sub–section(1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land describedbelow is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under theprovisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called ‘‘Galhenakanda Mukalana’’ in totalextent of about 0.0759 Hectare, shown and described in the AdvanceTracing No. KU/NRM/2013/788 dated 23.04.2014, prepared by theSurveyor General, situated in the village of Handapangala inDambadeni Udukaha West Minor Division in the DivisionalSecretary's Division of Narammala in Kurunegala District, North-Western` Province and bounded as follows. :

01. Lot ‘‘A’’ – Galhenakanda Mukalana – Extent: About0.0759 HectareNorth: Lot No. 32 in Final Village Plan No. 568; East: Lot No. 33in Final Village Plan No. 568; South: Lot No. 33 in Final Village PlanNo. 568 and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha);West: Road (PradeshiyaSabha).
M. K. A. D. S. Gunawardana,Minister of Lands,
My Reference No.: 4-3/9/2013/WS/505.Ministry of Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.12th June, 2015.
